entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-01
entry.content:

Closed

  • Add transitive framework reference exclusion tests - Ensure that transitive framework references are not picked up by `CollectFrameworkReferences` #14778

PullRequests
